data.name: Naylah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nailah' meaning 'a comforter, consoler'. It is also mentioned in the Quran as a name for Maryam, the mother of Isa (Jesus) (Quran 19:23).
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Naylah is a name of Maryam (Mary), the mother of Isa (Jesus). It symbolizes comfort and consolation.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents spirituality, wisdom, and destiny-driven strength.

in_arabic.name: نايلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: تُعتَبَرُ النائلةُ من أسماءِ اللَهِ العَظيمِ، وتُستَعينُ عَنها في الحِفظِ والقَصْدِ، وَهِيَ مِن أسماءِ الرَحمنِ الخَالي من الشُروقِ والخَفاءِ

in_urdu.name: نایلاہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کے سامع اور دیکھنے والے کا نام، اللہ تعالیٰ پر تکیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نایلاہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک پُر فائدہ مندا نام ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے سامع اور دیکھنے والے ہیں۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ پر تکیہ کرتے ہوئے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नायला
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का नाम जो सब कुछ देखता और सुनता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नायला अल्लाह का एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो सब कुछ देखता और सुनता है। यह नाम अल्लाह के प्रति ताकत और भरोसे में है

in_pashto.name: نایله
in_pashto.meaning: ډیرو دیکر، ډیرو دیکر، ډیرو دیکر
in_pashto.long_meaning: نایله دېکښېدونکي او دیکرښېدونکي دی، دې لویو پوهو څخه دښته ده، دې دښته پوهو څخه لوی دی، دې دښته پوهو څخه په کښېدلو کې ډېر دی

in_english.name: Naylah
in_english.meaning: The all-hearing, all-seeing name of Allah, who trusts in Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Naylah is the name of Allah who is all-hearing and all-seeing, and who trusts in Allah. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'n-y-l' which means 'to trust' or 'to rely on'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naylah holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it evokes the essence of comfort, solace, and consolation. In many societies, parents name their children with names that reflect qualities they would desire for them to embody in life. Naylah is a name that symbolizes the idea of being a source of comfort and support for those around them, which is highly cherished in many Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Naylah can be found in its religious meaning as a reference to Maryam (Mary) in the Quran (19:23). Ms. Maryam is regarded as a paragon of faith and devotion in Islamic tradition. The name Naylah carries the blessings and inspiration of this revered Figure, bringing to mind the idea of being a source of comfort and consolation, not just to others, but also to oneself in times of hardship, as Ms. Maryam did when she sought solace in seclusion while pregnant with Jesus, peace be upon him.

historical_references.reference: Naylah bint Al-Akhdar was a prominent Ansari woman who participated in the Battle of Uhud. She is famous for shielding the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) from an attack by the enemy during the battle, using her own body as a barrier.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic History, Battle of Uhud, Prophet Muhammad's Companions, Ansar (Helpers)

historical_references.reference: Naylah bint As'ad was a wife of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second Caliph of Islam. She is known for her piety and religious devotion, and is considered a role model for Muslim women.
historical_references.context: Later Islamic History, Umar ibn Al-Khattab, Muslim Women, Model of Piety
